paragraphs.en: The port museum planned to unveil an archive about the families who had helped build the city. Its most valuable item was an autobiography written by a retired diplomat, whose account began with a childhood journey from a distant homeland. He recalled jetlag on later trips, but his earliest memory was the smell of diesel beside a maritime warehouse. An old chapel and a small ranch appeared in the same chronicle. Together they challenged the notion that a city’s history could be reduced to its most famous buildings. A city on the brink of major redevelopment needed such accounts to understand what it might lose as well as what it hoped to gain.
paragraphs.zh: 港口博物馆计划公开一批档案，介绍帮助建设城市的家庭。最珍贵的一件是退休外交官的自传，叙述从儿时离开遥远故土的旅程开始。他记得后来旅行中的时差反应，但更早的记忆是海运仓库旁的柴油气味。一座旧礼拜堂和一处小牧场出现在同一部编年记录里。它们共同质疑一种看法：城市历史可以缩减为最著名的建筑。对于正面临大规模重建的城市，这些记录有助于理解可能失去什么，也理解希望获得什么。

paragraphs.en: In the archive, a clan of dockworkers described an ordeal during a wartime shortage. A food ration had to stretch across several households, and a little spice transformed a plain pudding into a family treat. The workers continued to reside near the harbor despite the peril of raids. When the authorities threatened to imprison a protest leader, neighbors made a vow to protect his children. The account did not invite readers to emulate danger; it showed how ordinary choices became difficult when institutions failed.
paragraphs.zh: 档案里，一个码头工人家族讲述了战时短缺中的艰难经历。一份食物配给要分给多个家庭，一点香料便能把朴素布丁变成家人的小小享受。即便遭空袭的危险存在，工人仍住在港口附近。当当局威胁要监禁抗议领袖时，邻居们发誓保护他的孩子。这个故事不是鼓励读者模仿冒险，而是展示制度失灵时，日常选择怎样变得艰难。

paragraphs.en: The museum faced its own decisions about presentation. A designer proposed an ultra-modern display in which visitors could swipe rapidly through an assortment of images. A historian worried that visual excitement would tempt people to cram a century into a minute. The staff agreed to allot enough space for careful reading and to retain the rigor of the original documents. They refused to censor criticism merely because it made a celebrated figure less admirable. A relic should invite inquiry, not become an object of unquestioning worship.
paragraphs.zh: 博物馆自身也面临展示方式的选择。设计师建议采用超现代装置，让游客快速滑过各类图片。历史学者担心视觉刺激会诱使人把一个世纪挤进一分钟。工作人员同意为认真阅读分配足够空间，并保留原始文献的严谨性。他们拒绝仅因批评削弱名人的光辉就将其删掉。遗物应引发探究，而不是成为毫不质疑的崇拜对象。

paragraphs.en: Public debate became intense when the council proposed to enact new preservation rules. A cynical columnist called the plan a cult of the past. Another warned that restrictions could derail a needed metro extension as urban sprawl reached the waterfront. Neither position captured the full problem. Under a haze of slogans, the choice seemed stark: preserve everything or dismantle everything. The archive instead revealed a slow trickle of adaptation. People had always changed their surroundings while arguing about which memories deserved to remain.
paragraphs.zh: 议会提议制定新的保护规则时，公共争论变得激烈。一位愤世嫉俗的专栏作者把计划称为对过去的狂热崇拜。另一位警告，随着城市蔓延至滨水地带，限制可能使必要的地铁延伸工程受挫。两种观点都没有完整抓住问题。在口号的迷雾中，选择似乎截然二分：全部保留，或者全部拆除。档案却揭示了缓慢持续的适应。人们一直在改变环境，也一直在争论哪些记忆值得留下。

paragraphs.en: On opening day, an elderly bridge player called her granddaughter an ace researcher for finding a missing letter. The girl replied that it was awesome to converse with people rather than merely search a screen. A science room nearby invited visitors to marvel at the cosmos, while a health exhibition explained cholesterol without promising miracles. The connection was curiosity: visitors could crave understanding without accepting every connotation of a familiar phrase. To equate preservation with immobility was a mistake. The archive became a cornerstone of change precisely because it encouraged reflection instead of expecting people to understand a century in the time it took to blink. As further documents arrived, the museum promised to revise its account, treating incompleteness as a reason for continued investigation rather than an embarrassment to conceal.
paragraphs.zh: 开放当天，一位爱打桥牌的老人夸孙女找到了遗失书信，是研究高手。女孩回答，与人交谈而不仅是搜索屏幕，真的很棒。旁边的科学室让游客惊叹宇宙，健康展则解释胆固醇而不许诺奇迹。它们的共同点是好奇心：人们可以渴望理解，又不必接受熟悉说法的每一种隐含意义。把保护等同于不动是错误的。档案恰恰因为鼓励反思，而非期待人们眨眼间就理解一个世纪，成为改变的重要基础。随着更多文献到来，博物馆承诺修订叙述，把不完整视为继续调查的理由，而不是需要隐藏的尴尬。
